raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The public CuTe DSL 4.8.0 CI lanes fail three SM107 D512 backward rendering checks because their committed hashes still describe the October 9 source. The dense CLC scheduler changed in #1547, and #1796 replaced the shared THD decoder and updated the probe metadata geometry.

Refresh those three records for the current implementation and document how to check helper/probe changes when maintaining PTX records. Compiler-version gating, hash comparisons and SASS assertions remain in place.

Validation with an isolated, complete public CuTe DSL 4.8.0 Python 3.12 package set:

- Historical source/probes generated all three old records twice in separate processes; current source/probes generated all three CI-observed hashes twice.
- Restoring only the historical kernel, scheduler, backward decoder and probe geometry in the current tree recovered all three old hashes. Raw PTX differences were inspected.
- On exact fix head `a00362e07db9`, the committed-record check, three hash comparisons and both existing SM107 D512 SASS checks passed: **6 passed, no skips or failures**.
- Changed-file hooks and `git diff --check` passed.

This updates test data and test-maintenance guidance only. The validation above is compiler coverage; it does not clear the separate staged-artifact timeout or SM103 D192 spill failures in the broader CI run.

files.patch:
@@ -110,6 +110,16 @@ pytest gemm/cutedsl/                  # CuTe DSL kernel tests
 
 ### Native flavor routing assertions
 
+PTX hash records also depend on imported helpers and the trace probe's fake
+tensor geometry. A scheduler or shared decoder change can invalidate a record
+even when the kernel file itself is unchanged. Before refreshing a record,
+render its historical source/probe and the current source/probe with the same
+recorded compiler distribution in separate processes, compare the PTX changes,
+and retain the existing SASS checks. Check distribution metadata as well as the
+import path: an internal build may print the public version in `cutlass.__version__`.
+`test_fork_rendering_ptx_md5_is_recorded` covers the SM107 D512 backward record;
+its dense scheduler and shared THD work-prefix changes require different attribution.
+
 When a native head-dimension flavor replaces an envelope, update the exact
 template expectation in existing end-to-end routing tests as well as adding
 new flavor tests. Keep the routing assertion, numerical comparisons and shape

@@ -1,7 +1,8 @@
-# Refreshed 2026-10-09 for the per-CTA empty-phase observer ACK protocol.
+# Refreshed 2026-10-24 from develop 68a8dafa4547 for the dense CLC scheduler
+# credits (#1547) and shared THD work-prefix decoder/probe geometry (#1796).
 # Default renderings, all debug levers off; each rendered twice in independent processes.
 # PTX text depends on the DSL build; tests compare only when the dsl line matches.
 dsl=nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.8.0
-stage2_2x2 sm_107a dense_bf16 rc=0 ptx_md5=ec5cccfc716d4328846176cc9626feba
-stage2_2x2 sm_107a causal_bf16 rc=0 ptx_md5=62d348cd72a1c8b81b5bfece48888d13
-stage2_2x2 sm_107a thd_bf16 rc=0 ptx_md5=a9a60d0cb2df5b67f43d9aa91faa339b
+stage2_2x2 sm_107a dense_bf16 rc=0 ptx_md5=3de59ff7ab21e5beb37214440e27814a
+stage2_2x2 sm_107a causal_bf16 rc=0 ptx_md5=019ca45cfd6a85fd5a33d7617dcbecd0
+stage2_2x2 sm_107a thd_bf16 rc=0 ptx_md5=5d8bafd4483353cc3d422d93b38c4430
